title: ArkaisTemplateEnvelope
description: Standardized schema envelope for publication-grade scientific figures and tables in Project Arkais.

$schema.description: Optional URI pointing to this schema version.

id.description: Unique canonical identifier (e.g., fig.physics.scatter.pareto_frontier.v1 or tbl.cs.benchmarks.model_comparison.v1).

version.description: SemVer version string of the template.

name.description: Human-readable publication title of the asset.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the visual asset, scientific utility, and expected data encoding.

tags.description: Taxonomy tags for semantic search and registry indexing.

engine.description: Declarative rendering engine targeted by this template.

min_engine_version.description: Minimum required version of the rendering engine or Arkais runtime.

author.description: Creator or maintainer organization (e.g., The Next Geek Think (NGT)).

license.description: SPDX license expression governing the template definition.

provenance_ark.description: Optional ARK accession identifier of the grounded historical paper inspiring this archetype.

recommended_gate.description: Arkais Stylometric Quality Gate enforcing this visual asset (e.g., GATE-07, GATE-08).

weaving_archetype.description: Rhetorical pattern governing how this asset is referenced in scholarly prose.

in_prose_blueprint.description: Template prose string with format tokens (e.g. {fig_ref}, {x_min}, {y_val}, {units}). Must avoid detached phrasing like 'Figure 1 shows'.

required_metrics.description: Key quantitative metrics that must be populated in the prose reference (e.g., p_value, sample_size, ci_95).

unit_discipline.description: Physical unit system standard (e.g., GATE-08 SI standard units).

grounding_rules.description: Stylometric assertion rules to prevent hallucinated narrative bounds.

caption_blueprint.description: Academic caption pattern for the figure or table (e.g., 'Figure {num}: {title}. Error bars represent 95% confidence intervals.').

notes.description: Academic footnotes, significance level indicators (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01), or corpus data source attributions.

parameters.description: Configurable parameter definitions supported by the template spec.

spec.description: The engine-specific declarative specification. Vega-Lite JSON object, LaTeX booktabs string/object, Matplotlib config, or Mermaid string.

sample_data.description: Representative dataset enabling instant out-of-the-box rendering and unit testing.
